english.title: Fluent English: Global Communication
english.descriptionLong: Dive into mastering English with our 'Fluent English: Global Communication' course. Designed based on the world’s best practices, this course transforms your language skills from theory to confident practice. Discover new opportunities in your career and travels, learn to express your thoughts freely, and understand the nuances of English-speaking cultures. We offer interactive real-life dialogue simulations, individual coaching sessions with native speakers, and access to an exclusive library of materials.

certificates.certificate1: Fluent English: Global Communication Course Completion Certificate
certificates.certificate2: Recommendation Letter from the Instructor (upon request)

module1.title: Fundamentals of Communication and Grammar
module1.description: Reinforcing basic rules and vocabulary for everyday communication.

module2.title: Vocabulary Expansion and Idioms
module2.description: Learning advanced vocabulary, phrasal verbs, and idiomatic expressions.

module3.title: Business Correspondence and Presentations
module3.description: Skills for effective business communication: letters, reports, public speaking.

module4.title: Cultural Nuances and Accents
module4.description: Understanding regional accents and cultural subtleties of English-speaking countries.

module5.title: International Exam Preparation (IELTS/TOEFL)
module5.description: Learning strategies and tactics for successfully passing international language exams.

math.title: Logic and Beyond: Mathematics for the Future
math.descriptionLong: Discover the beauty and logic of mathematics with our 'Logic and Beyond: Mathematics for the Future' course. This course is not just about formulas and numbers; it’s about developing analytical thinking, solving complex problems, and applying mathematical concepts in real life. We use interactive visualizations, gamified teaching methods, and practical case studies to make math engaging and understandable. Ideal for university preparation or enhancing critical thinking.

certificates.certificate1: Logic and Beyond: Mathematics for the Future Course Completion Certificate

module1.title: Fundamentals of Algebra and Functions
module1.description: In-depth exploration of algebraic expressions, equations, and functions.

module2.title: Geometry: From Euclid to Fractals
module2.description: Learning planimetry, stereometry, and an introduction to non-Euclidean geometry.

module3.title: Probability Theory and Statistics
module3.description: Fundamentals of probability theory, statistical data analysis, and forecasting.

module4.title: Mathematical Analysis: Derivatives and Integrals
module4.description: Derivatives, integrals, and their applications in various fields.

biology.title: BioSphere: From Cell to Ecosystem
biology.descriptionLong: Unlock the secrets of life with the 'BioSphere: From Cell to Ecosystem' course. This course offers an in-depth and engaging journey through biology, from microscopic organisms to complex ecosystems. You’ll conduct virtual lab work, analyze real scientific data, and participate in discussions on the latest discoveries. Ideal for future doctors, biologists, and those curious about the natural world.

certificates.certificate2: One-year access to a database of scientific articles and research

module1.title: Molecular Biology and Genetics
module1.description: Studying DNA, RNA, proteins, and the basics of heredity.

module2.title: Cellular Biology and Microorganisms
module2.description: Structure and functions of cells, and the world of bacteria and viruses.

module3.title: Human Anatomy and Physiology
module3.description: Functioning and interaction of human organ systems.

module4.title: Ecology and Biodiversity
module4.description: Studying ecosystems, interconnections in nature, and species conservation issues.

module5.title: Evolution and the Origin of Life
module5.description: Evolutionary theories, adaptations, and the history of life on Earth.

chemistry.title: Alchemy Secrets: Modern Chemistry
chemistry.descriptionLong: Master the language of atoms and molecules with the 'Alchemy Secrets: Modern Chemistry' course. This course transforms complex chemical processes into understandable and fascinating phenomena. You’ll conduct virtual experiments, analyze spectra, and learn to predict reactions. Ideal for those pursuing academic goals or simply curious about understanding the world of substances at a molecular level.

certificates.certificate1: Alchemy Secrets: Modern Chemistry Course Completion Certificate
certificates.certificate2: Six-month access to a chemical reaction simulator

module1.title: General Chemistry: Fundamentals of Matter Structure
module1.description: Studying atoms, molecules, chemical bonds, and the periodic table.

module2.title: Inorganic Chemistry: Elements and Compounds
module2.description: Properties and applications of key inorganic compounds.

module3.title: Organic Chemistry: The World of Carbon
module3.description: Studying hydrocarbons, functional groups, and reactions of organic compounds.

module4.title: Physical Chemistry and Kinetics
module4.description: Reaction energetics, equilibrium, and the speed of chemical processes.

it.title: Digital Flame: From Idea to Code
it.descriptionLong: Step into the world of the future with the 'Digital Flame: From Idea to Code' course. This intensive IT course is designed for those who want to become in-demand specialists in the field of information technology. You’ll master programming, web application development, databases, and cybersecurity basics. Practical tasks, real projects, and mentorship from leading IT professionals ensure a fast and effective start to your career.

certificates.certificate2: Certificate of Participation in an Open Source Project

module1.title: Programming Fundamentals (Python/JavaScript)
module1.description: Learning syntax, algorithms, and data structures.

module5.title: DevOps and Cloud Technology Fundamentals
module5.description: Deployment, containerization, and introduction to cloud platforms.

module6.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
module6.description: Basic principles of protecting data and systems.

robotics.title: RoboCraft: Engineering Thinking and Design
robotics.descriptionLong: Create the future with your own hands with the 'RoboCraft: Engineering Thinking and Design' course. This course offers an exciting dive into the world of robotics, from design to programming autonomous systems. You’ll work with real robotics platforms, learning the basics of mechatronics, electronics, and artificial intelligence. Ideal for young engineers and inventors dreaming of their own smart machines.

certificates.certificate2: Participation in the Final Project (creating your own robot)

drawing.title: Artistic Flow: From Sketch to Masterpiece
drawing.descriptionLong: Unleash your inner artist with the 'Artistic Flow: From Sketch to Masterpiece' course. This course is designed for those with any level of training to master the art of drawing. We explore various techniques from classical drawing to digital art and help you develop your unique style. Individual consultations with experienced artists and participation in virtual exhibitions await you.

certificates.certificate1: Master of Drawing and Composition Certificate

russian.title: Great Russian: From A to Z
russian.descriptionLong: Discover the richness of the Russian language and culture with the 'Great Russian: From A to Z' course. This course offers comprehensive learning of the Russian language, from grammar basics to the nuances of literary style. You’ll read classic and modern literature, watch Russian films, and participate in lively discussions. Ideal for those who want to communicate fluently, read, and understand the Russian-speaking world.

oratory.descriptionLong: Master the art of confident speech with the 'Voice and Impact: Mastering the Art of Public Speaking' course. This course helps you build confidence in public speaking, structure your thoughts, and deliver them effectively to any audience. You’ll work on diction, intonation, gestures, and facial expressions. Ideal for leaders, teachers, managers, and aspiring thought leaders.

computerLiteracy.descriptionLong: Master the digital world with the 'Digital Navigator: Computer Literacy for Everyone' course. This course is designed for those who want to confidently use computers and the internet in everyday life and work. You’ll learn to work with basic software, search for information securely, communicate online, and much more. The course is based on practical tasks and real-life usage scenarios.
